storage_rules: For invoke_agent work items, payload_json carries owner_kind and owner_id as canonical execution ownership. The work_items.stage_id column remains an optional origin-stage compatibility hint and may not become the durable owner key for mediation-owned work.

claim_scope_key, cancellation_scope_key, requeue_scope_key, and repair_scope_key are deterministic functions of run_id plus owner_kind plus owner_id plus work_item_kind, so startup recovery and duplicate claim repair can make the same decision after crash or host interruption.

artifact source-generation claims, retry budgets, and ignored-late-output settlement must consume the same owner-aware keys as the work-item contract rather than deriving identity from stage_execution_id.

owner_kind_behavior_matrix.claim_cancel_repair_rule: Claim, cancel, retry, and repair remain scoped to the stage execution owner key. Existing stage-only scheduling behavior is preserved.
Claim, cancel, requeue, repair, and ignored-late-output handling are scoped to the mediation owner key. stage_execution_id may be null and may never be synthesized to preserve queue compatibility.
